# Waleed Property

> Independent Oman real-estate advice for foreign and GCC buyers, by Waleed Al Abri, a real estate advisor in Muscat. Dated prices, current law (2026), and plain answers on ownership, residency and off-plan safety. Buyers pay nothing: the developer pays the broker commission. WhatsApp: +968 79136646.

Waleed Property publishes dated answers to the questions foreign buyers ask about Oman property. Legal content cites the current laws: Royal Decree 79/2025 (Real Estate Regulation Law, in force 10 March 2026, replacing RD 30/2018) and ROP Decision 87/2026 (owner residency, effective 22 June 2026). Every price on the site shows the date it was checked.

## Guides

- [Can foreigners buy property in Oman?](https://waleedproperty.com/can-foreigners-buy-property-in-oman): Where foreigners can own, ITC freehold vs usufruct vs lease, and how nationality changes the map.
- [Does buying property in Oman give you residency?](https://waleedproperty.com/oman-residency-by-property): The sponsor-free Owner Residency (ROP 87/2026), off-plan buyer visas before handover, and the 10-year Golden Residency at OMR 200,000.
- [Property in Oman you can buy as a foreigner: projects and prices](https://waleedproperty.com/property-for-sale-in-oman-for-foreigners): 14 projects open to foreign buyers, each price dated and sourced. Arabic version: https://waleedproperty.com/ar/property-for-sale-in-oman-for-foreigners
- [Oman off-plan prices 2026](https://waleedproperty.com/oman-property-prices-2026): Off-plan prices by area, each with a date and source.
- [Is off-plan property safe in Oman?](https://waleedproperty.com/is-off-plan-property-safe-in-oman): The 2026 escrow law (RD 79/2025), what escrow does not cover, and the checks before paying any deposit.
- [Can GCC citizens buy property in Oman?](https://waleedproperty.com/can-gcc-citizens-buy-property-in-oman): The GCC ownership rules and how they differ from the rules for other foreigners.
- [Sultan Haitham City guide](https://waleedproperty.com/sultan-haitham-city-guide): Oman's new city: who can buy, the Ministry of Housing residency rule (30% paid), and entry prices.
- [Al Mouj Muscat guide](https://waleedproperty.com/al-mouj-guide): Oman's flagship ITC: prices and a plain read on its investment case.
- [Oman investment guide](https://waleedproperty.com/oman-investment-guide): Overview of buying property in Oman as a foreigner.
- [Muscat property supply and demand 2026](https://waleedproperty.com/muscat-property-supply-and-demand-2026): New supply vs demand in Muscat, with sources.
